name: angeo/module-mcp-server
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Magento 2 — gives AI agents (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, custom assistants) live, structured, rate-limited access to your catalog: product search, product cards, categories, and store info. Read-only by default, no scraping required.

suggest.angeo/module-ucp: Publish a /.well-known/ucp profile that advertises this MCP endpoint to UCP-compliant agents
suggest.angeo/module-llms-txt: Generate llms.txt discovery files that link agents to this server
